description: Interactive Heavily Unbalanced Power System Analysis is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Pablo Arboleya (Universidad de Oviedo). In order to see and interact with the case of study open the case_of_study.html file with an internet browser, it should work in all browser but we tested in Google Chrome, Firefox and Safari.Once the file is open, we will see something like the attached figure. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
